name: Search/projection
description: _elements and _summary projection conformance tests against a single PUT-upserted Patient fixture (id=ignixa-projection-pat1) that carries a narrative, active, name, gender, and non-summary communication field. All projection searches are scoped by _id=ignixa-projection-pat1 for guaranteed isolation. Covers: _elements=active (field narrowing with SUBSETTED implication), _summary=text (narrative isolation), _summary=data (data-only, narrative absent), _summary=true (summary fields retained, non-summary communication absent), and _summary=count combined with _lastUpdated=ge2000 (count-only, no match entries).

text.div: Projection suite fixture: PROJECTION-PAT1, active, female, with communication data

operation.description: PUT Patient/ignixa-projection-pat1 — upsert fixture: active=true, name (Projection/Pat1), gender=female, non-summary communication, and narrative div

test.name: setup PUT response is 200 or 201
test.description: The fixture PUT must return exactly 200 OK for an update or 201 Created for a create; grouped warningOnly alternatives produce a hard failure when neither status matches.

assert.description: Update alternative: setup PUT returns 200 OK
Create alternative: setup PUT returns 201 Created

test.name: _elements=active: active field projected, name omission warningOnly, SUBSETTED implication warningOnly
test.description: GET /Patient?_id=ignixa-projection-pat1&_elements=active must return HTTP 200, a searchset Bundle, and the fixture entry with active=true. Name omission is warningOnly because servers may legitimately return extra elements beyond those requested. If name IS absent the server SHOULD mark the resource SUBSETTED — this is warningOnly per R4/R4B: servers are not obliged to return only requested elements, so the SUBSETTED implication is advisory.

assert.description: Fixture patient must appear in the result set
Fixture patient active element must equal true — _elements=active must retain the requested field
Name should be absent when _elements=active narrows the projection — warningOnly because extras are permitted
SUBSETTED implication (warningOnly): if name is absent the server omitted data, so meta.tag should carry the SUBSETTED marker; if name is present the implication is vacuously satisfied

test.name: _summary=text: narrative present, data omission warningOnly, SUBSETTED conditional warningOnly
test.description: GET /Patient?_id=ignixa-projection-pat1&_summary=text must return HTTP 200, a searchset Bundle, and the fixture entry with text.div present. Ordinary data fields (active, name, gender) should be absent — warningOnly because servers may include extra elements. Communication absence drives a warningOnly SUBSETTED conditional per R4/R4B: either communication is present (server was generous) or the resource should carry the SUBSETTED tag.

assert.description: Fixture patient must appear in the result set
_summary=text should omit ordinary data fields (active, name, gender) — warningOnly because servers may include extra elements beyond the required narrative

SUBSETTED conditional (warningOnly): communication should be present or the resource should carry the SUBSETTED tag — per R4/R4B servers SHOULD mark subsetted resources but are not obliged to return only requested elements

test.name: _summary=data: data fields present, narrative omission warningOnly, SUBSETTED conditional warningOnly
test.description: GET /Patient?_id=ignixa-projection-pat1&_summary=data must return HTTP 200, a searchset Bundle, and the fixture entry with all data fields (active, name, gender, communication) present. The narrative (text) should be absent — warningOnly because servers may include extra elements. Text absence drives a warningOnly SUBSETTED conditional per R4/R4B: either text is present (server was generous) or the resource should carry the SUBSETTED tag.

assert.description: Fixture patient must appear in the result set
_summary=data should omit the narrative (text) — warningOnly because servers may include extra elements beyond the required data fields

SUBSETTED conditional (warningOnly): text should be present or the resource should carry the SUBSETTED tag — per R4/R4B servers SHOULD mark subsetted resources but are not obliged to return only requested elements

test.name: _summary=true: Patient summary fields present, communication omission warningOnly, SUBSETTED conditional warningOnly
test.description: GET /Patient?_id=ignixa-projection-pat1&_summary=true must return HTTP 200, a searchset Bundle, and the fixture entry with known Patient summary fields (active, name, gender) present. Communication should be absent (non-summary Patient field) — warningOnly because servers may include extra elements. Communication absence drives a warningOnly SUBSETTED conditional per R4/R4B. The Patient resource summary flag (defined per the FHIR specification) includes active, name, and gender but excludes communication.

assert.description: Fixture patient must appear in the result set
_summary=true should omit communication (non-summary Patient field) — warningOnly because servers may include extra elements

SUBSETTED conditional (warningOnly): communication should be present or the resource should carry the SUBSETTED tag — per R4/R4B servers SHOULD mark subsetted resources but are not obliged to return only requested elements

test.name: _summary=count with _lastUpdated=ge2000: total=1, no match entries, outcome entries guarded
test.description: GET /Patient?_id=ignixa-projection-pat1&_summary=count&_lastUpdated=ge2000 must return HTTP 200, a searchset Bundle, Bundle.total=1 (the fixture was PUT this century and _id isolates it exactly), an empty match-mode entry list, and — if any entries are present — each must be an OperationOutcome with search.mode='outcome'. The all() assertion is vacuously satisfied when entry is empty.

assert.description: Bundle.total must equal 1 — the fixture patient was PUT this century and _id isolates it exactly
_summary=count must return no match-mode entries; outcome entries (OperationOutcome) are allowed
Every entry present must be an OperationOutcome with search.mode='outcome' — vacuously satisfied when entry is empty
